article.title: Iran’s Supreme Court upholds death sentence for a fruit seller arrested in connection with nationwide protests
paras: Editor's note: This story was translated from the original VOA Persian article.
A U.S.-based rights organization says that Iran's Supreme Court has upheld the death sentence against a fruit seller convicted in connection with anti-government protests earlier this year.
The Human Rights Activists News Agency (HRANA), the media arm of the Human Rights Activists in Iran, reported Monday that the court reached the decision in the case against Arman Marefati.
The group also said that two female protesters arrested in connection with the protests have been sentenced to a combined 44 years in prison.

Marefati was convicted in March 2026 by an Islamic revolutionary court in Tehran on charges alleging participation in activities against national security, entering religious sites with the intent to destroy them, and participating in the burning of a mosque and a religious seminary.
He has been transferred to from Greater Tehran Prison to Qezel Hesar Prison in Karaj in June where political and death-row prisoners are held.

His two co-defendants in the case, Mehrdad Mohammadiania and Ashkan Maleki, were executed in June after they were convicted of allegedly cooperating with Israel and hostile governments, creating insecurity and public fear, destroying and setting fire to public property, and participation in activities against national security.
Rights group Amnesty International said the executions were carried out without advance notice to their families or lawyers.

Marefati who is believed to be 38 years old, is originally from Saqqez County and lived in Tehran when he was arrested during nationwide protests in January 2026. He worked at a fruit and vegetable market, HRANA reported.

U.S. President Donald Trump, in early September accused Iranian officials of crimes against humanity over the regime's repression, killing, and execution of protesters and called for them to be brought to justice.

The U.S. State Department in its 2026 Human Rights report has also condemned issuance of death sentences against protesters and government opponents on security-related charges, including capital charges known locally as Moharebeh and cooperation with foreign countries.

Thousands of Iranians participated in protests that began late last year and continued into this year over economic hardships, including a sharp devaluation of the country’s currency. From the outset, however, demonstrators called for the overthrow of the Islamic Republic.
President Trump told world leaders on September that Iran had killed 72,000 of its citizens this year.

Iran has claimed the number of deaths related to the protests to be at 3,038; however, a recent U.N. fact-finding mission concluded that true figures are "significantly" higher than the government reported.

Human rights organizations have repeatedly accused the Iranian authorities of using torture, prolonged solitary confinement and other forms of coercion to extract confessions from detainees, which are then used as evidence in prosecutions, including cases carrying the death penalty.

Rights groups have also raised concerns that defendants are subjected to unfair trials based on forced confessions and vague or politically motivated national security charges, as well as allegations they say are fabricated or unsupported by credible evidence.

Amnesty International and other rights organizations have documented cases in which defendants were denied meaningful access to lawyers and due process, raising concerns about the reliability of convictions and the use of the death penalty against protesters and government opponents.
zh: 伊朗最高法院維持對一名因涉及全國性抗議活動而被捕的水果販的死刑判決
編者註：本文翻譯自美國之音波斯語版原文。
一家總部位於美國的人權組織表示，伊朗最高法院已維持對一名水果販的死刑判決，該販因涉及今年稍早的反政府抗議活動而被定罪。
伊朗人權活動人士的媒體機構「人權活動人士新聞社」（HRANA）週一報導，法院已就針對阿爾曼·馬雷法蒂（Arman Marefati）的案件作出裁決。
該組織還表示，兩名因參與抗議活動而被捕的女性抗議者，共被判處44年有期徒刑。
2026年3月，馬雷法提被德黑蘭的一家伊斯蘭革命法院定罪，罪名包括參與危害國家安全的活動、意圖破壞宗教場所而闖入，以及參與焚燒一座清真寺和一所神學院。
他已於六月從大德黑蘭監獄被轉移至卡拉傑的克澤爾·赫薩爾監獄，該監獄收押政治犯及死囚。
本案中與他同為被告的梅赫達德·莫哈馬迪亞尼（Mehrdad Mohammadiania）和阿什坎·馬萊基（Ashkan Maleki），因被判定涉嫌與以色列及敵對政府合作、製造不安全感與公眾恐懼、破壞及縱火焚燒公共財產，以及參與危害國家安全的活動，已於六月被處決。
人權組織「國際特赦組織」表示，當局在執行死刑前，並未事先通知死囚的家屬或律師。
據信現年38歲的馬雷法蒂，原籍薩格茲縣，2026年1月全國性抗議活動期間被捕時，當時居住在德黑蘭。據HRANA報導，他當時在一家蔬果市場工作。
美國總統唐納德·川普於九月初指控伊朗官員因該政權鎮壓、殺害及處決抗議者而犯下危害人類罪，並呼籲將其繩之以法。
美國國務院在《2026年人權報告》中，亦譴責當局以涉及國家安全的罪名——包括當地稱為「莫哈雷貝」（Moharebeh）的死刑罪名，以及與外國合作等指控——對抗議者及政府反對者判處死刑。
數以千計的伊朗人參與了自去年年底開始並延續至今年的抗議活動，抗議原因包括經濟困境，其中尤以該國貨幣急劇貶值為甚。然而，示威者從一開始便呼籲推翻伊斯蘭共和國。
川普總統於九月向各國領導人表示，伊朗今年已殺害了72,000名本國公民。
伊朗聲稱與抗議活動相關的死亡人數為3,038人；然而，聯合國最近的一項實地調查團得出結論，認為實際數字比政府報告的數字「高出許多」。
人權組織一再指控伊朗當局利用酷刑、長期單獨監禁及其他形式的脅迫手段，迫使被拘留者供認罪行，而這些供詞隨後被用作起訴的證據，包括涉及死刑的案件。
人權團體也對以下情況表示關切：被告因被迫供認、模糊不清或出於政治動機的國家安全指控，以及據稱是捏造或缺乏可信證據支持的指控，而被迫接受不公正的審判。
國際特赦組織及其他人權組織已記錄多起案例，顯示被告被剝奪了有效接觸律師及獲得正當法律程序的權利，這引發了外界對定罪可靠性，以及對抗議者與政府反對者適用死刑的擔憂。
